scope: Krea 512x512 benchmark plans on the 0.0.1 release branch, Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0.1, under the shared GPU lock. Every iteration matched the independent references.
hostConditions: NOT a quiet window: concurrent development jobs ran outside the GPU lock (an H3 CPU oracle using ~8 cores and streaming ~65 GB of weights, other Python jobs); load average 12-15 and ~6 GB of swap in use. Model-reload-heavy paths (balanced fresh prompts, first images) are most affected.
comparison: Same-day quiet-window measurements on the parallel local line (krea-residency-load-path-2026-10-26.json): provided repeats 4.6-4.8 s, balanced fresh prompts 14.1 s median, resident 5.0 s. Resident results agree (5.02 s); balanced results here are dominated by reload contention and need a quiet-window re-measure before being quoted as this line's performance.
